providers.title: Fuchs criterion in every order
providers.scope: Every monic scalar differential operator of finite positive order with coefficients in k((t)), for any characteristic-zero field k, or in convergent complex meromorphic germs. Its cyclic connection is regular singular if and only if ord_t(a_i) >= -i for every i. For convergent coefficients, formal regularity gives the same convergent logarithmic lattice.

providers.title: Relative analytic generation in every projective dimension
providers.scope: Every coherent analytic sheaf on projective n-space times a polydisc, any n and any chosen base point, including torsion, singular supports and failure of base flatness. Finite global twist generation on the entire product after one base shrink, with the same base for every larger twist. Includes fixed-chart Laurent bounds, convergent matrix factorization, redundant generator gluing, coherent projective-line images, product induction, the finite symmetric-root quotient and split trace at branch points. General proper analytic images and operator regularity are separate theorem obligations.

providers.title: Coherence of the actual locally projective analytic operator image
providers.scope: Locally projective holomorphic maps of complex manifolds. Every coherent holomorphic sheaf has bounded coherent ordinary images. Coherent operator modules with an actual coherent global holomorphic generator near the compact fibre have bounded coherent actual transfer images, including every closed or singular support and bounded complexes with that cohomology hypothesis. Finite induced twists, target action, closed normal transfer and sufficient range [a-d_X,b+2d_X] are proved. An initial generator for every regular holonomic module and full arbitrary-proper analytic regularity remain required.

providers.scope: For Pn times a polydisc to the polydisc and every coherent analytic G on the source cotangent space, including singular support and nonflat input: the defined Rq_*Lj^*G is coherent in [-n,n]; its cohomology support lies in the cotangent transport of SuppG, and that transported set is closed analytic. Finite Koszul restriction and the unit-quotient proof of analyticity are supplied. Actual output filtration comparison, holonomicity and regularity remain separate proofs.

providers.title: Singular pieces and isotropic projective cotangent images
providers.scope: For a projective analytic projection and every closed reduced pure conic Lagrangian source characteristic set, the transported cotangent set is closed conic analytic, every irreducible component is generically isotropic, and its dimension is at most the target dimension. The finite-branch singular restriction lemma includes every analytic subvariety inside the singular locus. Countable rank charts and a proved Baire argument handle singular correspondence components. This is a geometric theorem; the actual output-filtration comparison is Theorem 5.12.

providers.title: Actual filtered images and analytic projective holonomicity
providers.scope: For locally projective holomorphic maps of complex manifolds, every coherent operator module with a supplied coherent global holomorphic generator or global good order filtration near the tested compact fibre has coherent derived image with actual good output filtrations and the characteristic transport inclusion in every degree. Holonomic input gives holonomic output, all singular supports and bounded complexes with the same cohomology hypothesis included. Graded Rees coherence, finite strict segments, actual target action, both derived specializations, exact analytic extension, uniform power-torsion removal and the symbol subquotient are proved. The initial generator for every analytic regular holonomic module, image regularity, and arbitrary-proper nonprojective maps remain separate obligations.

providers.title: Algebraic SNC boundary factors and every curve pullback
providers.scope: For every smooth proper SNC pair with smooth divisor components and every finite-rank curve-regular connection on its complement, the normalized algebraic meromorphic extension is regular holonomic, including all its boundary simple factors. Every algebraic open restriction and every algebraic smooth-curve pullback, including maps contained in boundary intersections, are included. Finite logarithmic subquotient hulls, conormal determinant/sign cancellation, regularity at infinity and all tangency/residue multiplicities are proved. Open restriction and supported smooth closed equivalence preserve regularity. No unchanged compactification of a pre-existing pair, full singular four-map stability or converse curve criterion is assumed.

providers.title: Arbitrary inverse transfer and singular supported graph base change
providers.scope: Every algebraic map between smooth separated finite-type varieties, all singular supports and bounded holonomic complexes. The fibre product is a support W in a smooth product, never an assumed smooth scheme. Direct composition, arbitrary inverse localization, curve tests of arbitrary SNC meromorphic pullbacks, supported tests, and the nonsingular embedded-curve criterion are proved with actual transfers and all dimension shifts. Low-image SNC direct-image regularity is unconditional; the higher-image reduction uses only the explicitly lower-support induction.

Full singular curve testing is not an input.
